verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury explicitly lets businesses keep operating cash in a Ramp Checking Account (2% APY) while reserve cash earns up to 4.46% in a linked Investment Account, without moving funds to a separate bank — funded by government money market funds and Treasuries, with FDIC pass-through insurance via a partner bank. This is documented as a first-party product feature (ramp-docs-29, ramp-supp-checking-account, ramp-supp-bank-transfer-automation) and is programmatically exposed via the Banking API (ramp-supp-banking-api). missing for 10: independent/hands-on customer verification of actual yield realized, and clarity on whether Investment Account funds are truly 'not moved to a separate institution' versus held via a custodial brokerage relationship.
